notes.title: The Woods will be retired from Store
notes.content:
[b]We are sorry to announce this and I have to say it isn't an easy decision, but we will stop working on The Woods, because of multiple reasons I want to get into detail here.
[/b]
First of all, we want to thank everyone who supported us to this day and whenever we will release another game with a fresh start we will thank each one with a coupon or even a copy, we will see, but right now there is a long way ahead of us.

As many might have followed from the latest news, time got a real problem for us to get our updates cooked and published and we definitely know that we messed this up since the start. We are a 2 man developer team, both working fulltime and The Woods was always planned as a side project, never aimed to be big, but we dreamed our dream bigger and failed because of that.

We knew we won't have the time nor the resources to full fill what we wanted to realize and many might see this as a scam, but it wasn't intended to be like that. We thought we could get the game there where we wanted it to be, but as said we dreamed too big for our possibilities.
At this moment a bunch of people, their meaning we valued, started to talk us into decisions we regret and pushed us to publish the game as fast as possible no matter what. Afterward, we really regret this but well mistakes are made to learn from, and we are not here to blame anyone for that. 

After the really bad start, I wanted to put all possible resources into this game to get it the way I dreamed of and started to redo the whole game from scratch again, put over 1000hrs into the development for 1 year. I might need to say, that I work as a game developer full time and have multiple projects running, so time became a really rare resource and I had to push back the updates over and over again.

In October this year, I realized that after all that time I spent on this project, the passion for this project gave way just for my personal ego to complete the project no matter what, just to show the potential we saw in our game instead of just canceling it and learn from made mistakes. 
After serious consideration, the decision was made, that a 2 man dev team with little time won't be able to get this game done in the next year so we decided to retire The Woods from the Steam Store.

At this moment we don't know if we will publish the update we prepared, but we might keep this option open if we find our way back to this project.

Anyway, we still want to create games for you, since it is our passion, but at this moment we are not sure when we still start again since we need some time to talk about a new project, plan it more through and learn from all made mistakes.

Again we want to thank everyone for the support you gave and mention again that this is not an easy decision for us since we are giving up a dream.

Have a nice week 

Cheers

Kevin from Moonware Games

notes.title: Final Update will need until Oktober 2019
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I am sorry to announce this, but the final update I was cooking the last months for you, will need some more time till release.
The reasons for this decision are mostly because of my fulltime daytime job, my fulltime university life I participate next to my daytime job and my currently low free time to finish the project. 
Also, I am currently the only one working on the project which delays all work I outsourced to my partner in the project, so I will need some more time to finish the project the way I dreamed of.

Many times I thought about cancelling the project because it is too much to do during my work time that there was no time for the project itself, but the last weeks and months I was able to sacrifice 2 to 3 hrs every day to work on the project again and to redo a lot of the work we had on our release, and not to forget, to improve it and to add in the new stuff we promised.

But because of the really bad start we had and my passion for this project,  I want to finish this project and show the real potential behind our team and the whole project.

So, for now, I will focus to get the update done till Oktober 2019 and to do some more detailing and fixes in November and December to finally get out of Early Access soon.

Here is a little teaser of something new coming to THE WOODS:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/5ef0ce2b9c645e356767d93e00f114becfe8ce03.jpg[/img]

TIll then 

Best wishes

Kevin from Moonware Games

notes.title: "Butterfly Effect" - Decision Based Gameplay
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

I want to get you some details about the concept of a new feature I was working on the last days.
The goal is to add decision-based gameplay, so whatever decision you take, it will have an impact on the game experience.
Of course, it is almost impossible to track every single decision made during the game, so I achieved a feature which marks the decisions which got an impact on the storyline. To replay different scenarios there will be a separate save file for each Story Decision made, so it is easy to load another scenario and try a different way.
As said every single interaction can and will have an impact on the game experience, but just these named "Story Decisions" will be available to replay once again, since they alter the story and end in a different outcome. 

Every other decision intensifies or calms the game experience depending on which way you choose but this may last just seconds before you take another way and change these elements again in a different direction. To do not oversaturate it, the changes will happen delayed and slightly.

I will upload graphics and a few more details about how this will work in the next two weeks.

Till then best wishes.

Cheers

Moonware Games

notes.title: New Level Design
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
it is a while since my latest announcement. I worked hard on some severe improvements of the overall level, including performance balances.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/a0bb9534328f34e6c608c0c090bdb10200d3ab7d.png[/img]

[i]To keep the scary atmosphere I increased the fog and lowered the lights. Even without a flashlight, it is possible to see silhouettes from a certain distance.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/9b19bfac899aa56f7db44db4690f329af17b5b85.png[/img]

[i]Also, I improved the road, added curves and slopes for a more realistic road. I also aligned the edges to the forest, so it will be possible to reach the street. Some parts of the road are easier to access (on ground level) others need to be climbed through a slope, but the overall edges are smoother and more realistic than before.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/92da4f58b610cc8aa270a1638ed28513c6fb1042.png[/img]



[i]As you might notice I also added a phone, which will primarily is used as a flashlight. But beware, since the battery can discharge from every usage[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/e58d593eedea74ddd47f950664a14bb92b5fadb8.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32400598/2e60b2a88ab19488cc0589ff836d7ff6b569e2f5.png[/img]

By the end of next week, I will set up a post about a new important feature which I am about to implement, till then best wishes.

notes.title: EDIT: Important information about delayed updates and end of Early Access
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we are very sorry that we couldn't follow our idea of updating The Woods in [b]August nor in November[/b]. Unfortunately, both of us had some tough time with private work and family. Still, we worked on elements of the updates but we never finished to put them all together.

Now we found some time and continued working on the updates, which will change many elements of the game and bring it to another level and hopefully make it better as it is now.

We will finish our game also by [b]Q2 2019[/b] and will leave Early Access then.
Since some elements changed during our development we will update the Steam Store Page as soon as possible, the latest with the next update.

[b]For the people who waited for the multiplayer, because of budget issues there won't be any multiplayer soon [/b]

Because of irregularities, we won't announce a particular update date.

We want to apologize again for the mess up and the hard delays. We will keep you up to date with video and images at least twice a month so you also will see our progress during our development.

Best wishes

Moonware Games

notes.title: Content Update 0.2 will arrive the 15th of June
notes.content:
As mentioned in the latest hotfix notes, we are going to release some new content for you (two days later than planned) and step into the version 0.2. which will hold a new character, some more NPC interactions and of course some new and cruel killer decisions and features. We also will add for the first time a decision-based game feature, where you either decide to do as the killer say or you gonna pay for it (Some more will come in near feature).

Also, there are some changes within the map design, adding some more hiding possibilities and cleaning up some display errors within the graphics.

Another big thing we looked into is the performance. Since we could get about 5 to 10 FPS out of the latest update, we worked on some more improvements to get a better performance for lower pc specs.

We want to thank everyone for your support so far and we are looking forward to some new feedback.

Have a nice Sunday evening

Cheers

Moonware Games

notes.title: The Woods in Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we launched our first game The Woods in Early Access. We are aware of missing content and some issues, and also we are looking forward polishing the game with you together, to find the right balance between hard and easy.

Please keep in mind, that the content shown is still early and we are working every day on updates, to launch new content once a week.

Also if you might encounter some issues with AI, starting the game, lags etc. please contact us before giving up on it, because we just can only fix it with your help.

We are looking forward to an amazing community work with you guys and we appreciate and are thankful for all your help and support.

Cheers,

Moonware Games
